name: Pixelorama
title: Pixelorama: free Aseprite alternative
hook: Aseprite charges you twenty bucks to draw and animate pixel art. This app does it for free.

features.intro: It's a full pixel art studio.
features.say: Animate with layers, frames and onion skinning, and draw while the animation plays.
Pixel perfect lines, palettes, and effects like outlines and drop shadows.
It exports to PNG, spritesheets and GIFs, and makes tilemaps for your games.

caption:
Aseprite charges $19.99 to draw and animate pixel art. Pixelorama does it for free 🎨

✅ Animate with layers, frames and onion skinning
✅ Pixel perfect lines, palettes and layer effects
✅ Export PNG, spritesheets and GIFs, plus tilemaps for games
✅ No subscription, no account, no ads

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The GitHub download is free. There's also an optional paid Steam copy ($9.99) if you want to support the devs. Aseprite is a $19.99 one-time purchase

Comment "SPRITE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
